body.voice_description: Create an original chess-coach voice for an illustrated character. Character: Ingrid, a relaxed, reassuring woman from Oslo and a strong chess player who keeps the chess honest. Voice direction: A woman's voice: relaxed female mezzo-soprano speaking English with a Norwegian accent and a gentle Scandinavian melody. Clearly feminine, calm, reassuring and candid, a shade brighter and lighter, with a clear lilt on key words. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: No harm in checking this one calmly. The defender moved, so that piece is loose, and the other side can take it. Next time, glance back first.
